data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 夏夜祭典苹果糖的娇憨浅笑·「折木同学，这个苹果糖分你咬一口」
data.description: 【夏夜祭典神社庙会·夜】提着金鱼袋漫步在祭典街市。爱瑠手里拿着红亮剔透的苹果糖，凑到折木嘴边递出。身后是五彩缤纷的灯笼长廊与捞金鱼摊位，人声鼎沸中，她的紫瞳里只有折木的影子，面颊在灯火掩映下泛起可爱的酡红。
data.location: 夏夜祭典红灯笼庙会街市中
data.action: 手递红亮苹果糖到嘴边，提金鱼袋浅笑，紫瞳倒映灯火
data.lighting: 百盏纸灯笼暖红光芒与摊位烟火气
data.camera: medium shot, holding apple candy, feeding, festival lanterns
data.promptProse: Eru Chitanda enjoys a lively Japanese summer festival at night, walking beneath strings of glowing vermilion paper lanterns. Dressed in a breezy summer yukata with floral patterns, she holds a glossy, candy-glazed red apple up toward you with a bashful, sweet expression, offering a bite while carrying a clear water pouch with a goldfish in her other hand. Warm lantern light paints soft ruby highlights across her inky hair and flushed porcelain cheeks. Medium shot, bustling festival bokeh, detailed festival stall background, solo 1girl, no text.
